results.title: Sosuke the Duck
results.overview: A girl learns about caring for a duck with special needs during her first year on the farm. An animated documentary rendered in plant based inks about a little runner duck who couldn't.  Director’s Statement: Sosuke was one of the first ducks on our farm. Created over the course of seven years, this animated short tells his story. The animation was created using digital rotoscoping (where the animator traces each frame of live action footage to create hand drawn scenes) and then printed onto over 2,400 pieces of printer paper and coloured in inks made by hand from flowers, nuts, vegetables and berries cultivated and foraged on our farm. This is a story about becoming more connected to ecology, about learning to farm, and what animals can teach us. It is told with colours from the landscape, including acorn, black walnut, goldenrod, sunflower, haskap berry, purple cabbage, sumac and more.

results.title: Peter
results.overview: A morning visit to Peter, the day begins.

results.title: Caledonia
results.overview: Ancient Caledonia 210AD. A young Roman Soldier is the lone survivor of a brutal shipwreck. He is injured and broken but not alone. The savage Pict inhabitants ensnare him in their gruesome blood sport, unflinching and persevering he will do anything to make it back to his beloved. throughout his perilous and unsettling journey he finds hope in the most unexpected of places.

results.title: People and Meat
results.overview: Three elderly people, all feeling the strain of life, accidentally come together. Two men, one woman. They are Woo-sick, Hyung-jun, and Hwa-jin. Their sole goal is to "grease their insides" by eating pork all around Seoul. Their mission is clear: to dine without paying a cent! As they enjoy free meat, their faces brighten up, they feel alive, and most importantly, they've made friends! Their friendship deepens as time passes.

results.title: The Untold Story of the Wilhelm Scream
results.original_title: The Untold Story of the Wilhelm Scream
results.overview: The Wilhelm Scream has made an appearance in hundreds of films, TV shows, video games, and commercials over the past 70 years. Now discover the story behind the most infamous joke in cinema history.

results.title: *Karaganda*: Red Mafia
results.overview: After destroying a Russian airbase in a botched arms deal, Brighton Beach gangster Vladimir must survive the ensuing mafia war and keep his family safe.

results.title: The Muppet Scriptmas Carol
results.overview: The Muppet Script returns to bring you THE MUPPET SCRIPTMAS CAROL! When most people think of the Muppets, they think of the colorful characters made out of fleece and foam. But as with every movie, it all starts on the written page. Before returning to the big screen, the Muppets team returned to the writers' room. Muppets scribe JERRY JUHL was inspired by CHARLES DICKENS’ classic holiday tale to take the gang to merry old London in the 1800’s, in their first movie without creator JIM HENSON, directed by his son, BRIAN HENSON. The movie featured the return of maestro PAUL WILLIAMS to craft a soundtrack that is just as timeless as Dickens’s original novel.

results.title: A Gunfighter's Deal
results.overview: In his darkest days, Silas Johnson gets a visit from a mysterious man who promises to make him the fast-gun that he has always wanted to be. But, at what cost?

results.title: Mr and Mrs Bachelor
results.overview: Stephy, a bride-to-be, escapes from her wedding and meets Siddhu, a carefree bachelor in his 40s. The film follows their spontaneous journey together filled with humorous and emotional moments.

results.title: Chaos and Silence
results.overview: As young musicians Jean and Helena brace for parenthood amidst job insecurities, their lives collide with landlord Klara's enigmatic breakdown. Accepting her offer of rent-free living, they embark on a surreal journey, encountering societal judgments and forming unexpected connections that shape their intertwined destinies.

results.title: Punch
results.overview: As Jacob tears through Nottingham in a whirlwind of drugs, girls, and bar fights, he makes a fatal mistake that lands him in prison. As he struggles to accept the consequences and build a new life, he finds an unusual source of salvation, the parents of the boy he killed. Based on a remarkable true story, Punch is two-time Olivier Award winner from playwright James Graham.

results.title: Measure in Love
results.overview: In a world split by a gravity wall where time moves differently, a woman from the Aurora Zone and a man from the Evergreen Zone fall in love, despite the impossible challenge that one day for her equals one year for him.

results.title: Moving Day
results.overview: As a couple packs up their longtime apartment, the move brings their shared history and complicated emotions to the surface.

results.title: Wicked: For Good - A Sneak Peek
results.original_title: Wicked: For Good - A Sneak Peek
results.overview: In an exclusive sneak peek, Angela Bishop heads down the yellow brick road to the land of Oz with the Wicked for Good cast, who spill some tea before the movie lands in cinemas on November 20.

results.title: Tullingdal: The Musical
results.overview: A Swedish general is going to build an international ballet academy in the village of Tullingdal. But he faces a tricky problem: the village's finest snowmobile trail runs exactly where the academy is supposed to be built.

results.title: Dean
results.overview: Based on the 1976 British musical Dean based on the life of James Dean.

results.title: Radiator Springs Racers | Disneyland Resort
results.overview: Start your engines! Because we're racing as part of the Disneyland® Resort 70th Celebration! Take a scenic and high-speed ride through Radiator Springs Racers in this immersive Point of View adventure. Tour Ornament Valley and arrive in Radiator Springs, the cutest little town in Carburetor County! From the roar of the engines to the charming Cadillac Range mountains, this Cars Land attraction has the perfect blend of heart and horsepower. Every twist, turn, and rev of the engine will have you experiencing the joy of seven decades of Disney imagination and innovative storytelling at top speed!

results.title: Silver
results.overview: In the silence and darkness of a trembling mountain, we discover the underground world through the eyes of a boy, an old miner and a woman. Where sweat mixes with the blood of history, a story emerges about colonial heritage and the endless cycle of exploitation.

results.title: Patrulla del clima
results.overview: Documentary that records the activities of a group of elementary school children in the "Art and Recycling" workshop, held in the summer of 2024. Guided by teachers, the students learn to reduce, recycle, and reuse through games and the creation of objects from recovered materials. The film follows them on field trips to the Tigre Delta, where they observe the biodiversity and the need to protect the ecosystem. Back at home, they apply what they have learned through actions such as turning off lights and saving water.

results.title: Fouetté
results.overview: Christina, a ballet dancer who struggles to earn her mother’s approval, is trying to succeed in an audition for which her mother is preparing her.
